Postconfig sends Ctrl+S before evaluation to flush unsaved VSCode editor state.
Evaluator fully covers the single requirement in the instruction: SNAKE_SIZE must equal 20.

Consider adding a step to focus settings.py before saving, or rely solely on the filesystem read (which already captures saved edits).
